title: Start from last week
description: Copy last week's schedule, fix the exceptions, and publish. Most managers post the week in under 15 minutes.

title: Swaps that approve themselves
description: Staff trade shifts from their phones. A swap goes through on its own when both people are trained for the role and under their hours cap.

title: Availability on file
description: Everyone sets the hours they can work once. The scheduler grays out the rest, so nobody gets booked on a Tuesday they asked off.

title: Overtime warnings before you publish
description: The week flags anyone crossing 40 hours while there is still time to move a shift, not after payroll runs.
